schema_version: 1
state: |-
  The human curation pass @wiki/specs/global-wiki-layer requires to land with or before the mechanism.

  - The mechanism prevents **new** divergence; it does not heal existing divergence. No machinery will recognise that `no-comments-naming-only` ≈ `no-comments-in-code`. Curation decides. Do **not** add fuzzy auto-merge or a machine synonym table — that masks a curation problem and would silently change which rule binds.
  - Establish the canonical set at `~/.wm/wiki/rules/` and collapse the measured clusters:
    - no comments: `no-comments-naming-only` / `no-code-comments` / `no-comments-in-code` ×2 (4 names)
    - spec-first: `spec-first` / `spec-first-workflow` / `spec-before-action` / `spec-driven-development` / `findings-first-task-spec` (5 names)
    - TDD: `tdd-red-green-refactor` ×2 / `tdd` (3 variants)
  - Resolve the same-name-different-content cases (`no-comments-in-code` 498 B vs 2149 B; `no-magic-values` 508 B vs 3190 B) — decide the single canonical text.
  - Port `/Users/nhkhanh/projects/AGENTS.md` (5,907 B) as source material. wm must **not** magic-path-read a per-user file; the owner ports it deliberately.
  - Decide global vs project-local per rule, then shadow only where a project genuinely diverges.
  - Risk being mitigated: `idle-incremental-game` has 0 rule pages today and would otherwise become bound by content it never had.

state: |-

  - Establish the canonical set at `~/.wm/wiki/rules/` and collapse the measured clusters:
    - no comments: `no-comments-naming-only` / `no-code-comments` / `no-comments-in-code` ×2 (4 names)
    - spec-first: `spec-first` / `spec-first-workflow` / `spec-before-action` / `spec-driven-development` / `findings-first-task-spec` (5 names)
    - TDD: `tdd-red-green-refactor` ×2 / `tdd` (3 variants)
  - Resolve the same-name-different-content cases (`no-comments-in-code` 498 B vs 2149 B; `no-magic-values` 508 B vs 3190 B) — decide the single canonical text.
  - Port `/Users/nhkhanh/projects/AGENTS.md` (5,907 B) as source material. wm must **not** magic-path-read a per-user file; the owner ports it deliberately.
  - Decide global vs project-local per rule, then shadow only where a project genuinely diverges.
  - Risk being mitigated: `idle-incremental-game` has 0 rule pages today and would otherwise become bound by content it never had.

  ## Plan (2026-10-15)

  **Phases.** Steps 1-4 are executable now and write nothing outside this repo. Steps 5-7 are **blocked on the composition mechanism** (`gwl-01`, `gwl-02`, `gwl-04`, `gwl-05`), because WM tools cannot write below `~/.wm/` while confinement is rooted at the project root.

  **Constraint found while planning — the spec's sequencing is inverted.** The superseded cascade text requires curation to land "by the time the cascade ships", so that no project is silently bound. That intent is satisfied *more* safely by the opposite order: **ship the mechanism with an empty `~/.wm/wiki/`, which binds nothing, then curate into it.** The stated risk — a project with zero rules suddenly bound — only materialises if the mechanism ships with uncurated content already present in the global root. Surfaced for approval because it changes the approved spec's sequencing.

  1. **Curation map.** Canonical slug plus merged text for each global candidate, absorbing the measured clusters: no-comments (4 names), spec-first (4), tdd (3), no-else (2), no-magic-values (2), parallel-execution (2). Plus the singleton global candidates: `agent-execution`/delegation, `language-english-only`, `commit-message-style`, `no-commit-agentic-files`, `open-questions-evidence-based`, `durable-write-or-error`, `no-warnings`, `no-dead-code-clone-scanning`, `no-compensating-layers`, `tool-reliability-bug-tracking`, `findings-first-task-spec`, `check-git-remote-for-pat`, `use-tuistory-for-dev`. Resolve each same-name-different-content pair by choosing one text. Deliverable: one reference page. (AC-1, AC-2)
  2. **Scope decision for all 46 pages** — global / project-local / retire. Project-local residue identified: eightcap's five `e2e-*` (~16 KB), `prefer-nested-scss`, `respect-file-tree-and-barrel-files`, `app-code-conventions` (Angular); axon's `ui-changes-design-system-first`; wiki-mem's `rust-anti-patterns`; and `no-allow-attributes` (draft) plus `doc-comment-convention` (superseded), which must not go global. (AC-1, AC-2)
  3. **Port `AGENTS.md`** (5,907 B) — map each section to an existing canonical rule, a new canonical rule, or explicitly out of scope. A deliberate owner port only; wm performs no path read of a per-user file. (AC-3)
  4. **Record the ordering and staging decision** — mechanism ships with an empty global root; curation populates it afterwards; staging is a repo artifact because confinement blocks out-of-root writes until then. (AC-4)
  5. *(blocked)* **Populate `~/.wm/wiki/rules/`** through the global write/promote surface; exercise collision refusal against the same-name-different-content pairs. (AC-1, AC-4)
  6. *(blocked)* **Shadow decisions per project** — which canonical rules each project keeps locally; record `idle-incremental-game` (0 rules) behaviour explicitly. (AC-4)
  7. *(blocked)* **Verify** with `wm-cli global audit`: zero same-slug-different-SHA across scopes and an empty name-cluster report. (AC-4)

  **Plan check.** AC coverage: AC-1 to steps 2 and 5; AC-2 to steps 1 and 2; AC-3 to step 3; AC-4 to steps 4, 6 and 7 — no uncovered AC. Sizing: seven steps, three of them blocked, so **splitting is recommended** into `curate-01a` (steps 1-4, executable now) and `curate-01b` (steps 5-7, blocked on gwl). Risk: step 5 has blast radius across all four projects, mediated by the trust gate and collision refusal. No code changes, no new dependencies.
